# orion telemetry

Choose whether this machine shares anonymous usage data

```sh
orion telemetry <command> [options]
```

## orion telemetry status

Show whether this machine shares anonymous usage data

```sh
orion telemetry status [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion telemetry on

Share anonymous usage data from this machine

```sh
orion telemetry on [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion telemetry off

Stop sharing usage data and delete this machine's install id

```sh
orion telemetry off [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |
